as_told.title: Lost time from 2 a.m. to dawn; friend declines regression hypnosis

plain: Richard Barth, who says he was a guard for nuclear missiles at Vandenberg Air Force Base in California, says that in September 1964 he woke up unable to move. He says that about two weeks after the event, a whole experience suddenly came flooding back to him, and he insists it was not a dream. He says there is a gap in his memory, which in another telling he places between 2 a.m. and dawn, adding that a friend turned down hypnosis to recover memories about twenty years later, and he credits people named Lonnie and Robert Hastings. He tells it because, if true, it would mean something took a missile guard away during his duty.
